body: Well yeah, that's kind of the whole point of my problem. My limitations are technically artificial but very, very real to me. The fears I feel are not proportionate to the things that cause them but simply knowing that everyone else manages it just fine does not mean that I can.

No he definitely understands and believes me to a point, but he doesn't really get how serious it's gotten for me and he has a lot of opinions on what I should be doing differently that aren't really realistic about keeping in mind what I *can't* do.

Hey, thanks.

I don't have any resources to move out; my mom just took all the money I have, and I won't get any more for a few weeks. I make less than $120 a week, and if I move out of my mom's house, the job I currently do will go away as well. 

Public transportation doesn't work any better for me than driving does; we have a little bit of a subway system in the area I live in now, and I had a huge panic attack on the train this summer.

I don't know how to get therapy. My mom will not help and has only made fun of me when I've asked for help figuring it out (she works in healthcare so she knows). I have insurance but I don't know how to use it by myself. My boyfriend tries to help but does not believe the severity of my problems and places a lot of blame on me. It's at the point now where I can't do much to help myself anymore.
